name: Atexxo Zone 1 Galaxy Tab Active5
summary: The Atexxo Zone 1 Galaxy Tab Active5 is a standard Samsung Galaxy Tab Active5 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It is a flameproof (Ex d) design, and the tablet runs Android 16.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 1 Galaxy Tab Active5, front view

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T85°C Db
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2026-09-09), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX revision 0 read from PDF 2026-10-25

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T6 Gb / Ex tb IIIC T85°C Db

safety.conditions: Ambient temperature range −20 °C ≤ Ta ≤ +50 °C. A repair of flameproof joints is not allowed according to EN/IEC 60079-1 values. Minimum property class of screws must be A4-70; only original parts from the manufacturer shall be used. The glass window must be protected from high impact energy > 2 J. Device shall not be opened in hazardous location. Battery charging is only allowed outside hazardous location. Additional accessory EX-ATEXXO-STRAP can be used only as original part from manufacturer.
safety.peripherals: SIM card installation only in a safe area, by removing the aluminium SIM cover. Bottom cover may be removed by the user only to charge in a safe area. No Ex-rated cable, dock or keyboard is listed, so none should be connected in the Ex area. Atexxo's page says storage can be extended to 1 TB with microSD; the certificate does not address microSD.
safety.certifiedAccessories: EX-ATEXXO-STRAP (named in the certificate; original part from Atexxo only). No Ex-rated keyboard, dock, pen or harness listed. Charger is not Ex-rated (charging only outside the hazardous area).

os.name: Android
os.edition: Android with One UI; Knox; Enterprise Edition and standard SKUs exist
os.upgradeLimit: Standard: up to 4 generations of OS upgrades (Samsung UK/AU). Enterprise Edition: up to 8 generations per Samsung DE page

specs.display: 8-inch TFT LCD, 120 Hz adaptive; Corning Gorilla Glass 5
specs.batteryLife: Video playback up to 16 h; Wi-Fi internet up to 14 h; LTE internet up to 15 h
specs.ports: USB-C (USB 2.0), 3.5 mm headset jack, POGO pins, microSD slot
specs.docking: POGO connector (Samsung POGO dock accessories not verified for this model)
specs.sim: 5G model: SIM plus eSIM ('dual SIM capability' in Samsung text; Atexxo: 'physical SIM and/or eSIM'); none on Wi-Fi model
specs.keys: Programmable Active Key (barcode, apps, PTT mapping via Knox); power and volume keys
specs.touch: Glove and outdoor touch claimed by Samsung
specs.pen: S Pen supported (IP68 S Pen in the box on the UK page)
specs.keyboard: POGO pins on the tablet; Samsung keyboard cover not confirmed for this model
specs.storage: 128 GB or 256 GB, microSD up to 1 TB
specs.ipRating: IP64 (Atexxo page; the Samsung base tablet itself is IP68)
specs.ruggedness: MIL-STD-810H compliant (Atexxo flyer and page; base-tablet rating)
specs.partNumbers: EXd-TABLET-GTA5-128 (Wi-Fi, 128 GB); EXd-TABLET-GTA5-128-CEL (Wi-Fi + 5G, 128 GB); EXd-TABLET-GTA5-256; EXd-TABLET-GTA5-256-CEL; EXd-TABLET-GTA5-* (conversion service for a customer's new Samsung tablet)

throughCase.label: Side and volume buttons
throughCase.value: Yes: push buttons are mounted in the housing and in the front cover (aluminium)

throughCase.label: Rear cameras
throughCase.value: Yes, behind a toughened glass opening in the housing

throughCase.label: Touchscreen
throughCase.value: Yes: front touch display under toughened specialty glass

throughCase.label: Screen cover
throughCase.value: Toughened specialty glass front window. Must be protected from impact energy above 2 J

throughCase.label: Charging
throughCase.value: Remove the aluminium bottom cover and charge in a safe area only. Charging in the hazardous location is forbidden

throughCase.label: USB-C port
throughCase.value: Only with the bottom cover removed in a safe area (charging)

throughCase.label: SIM card
throughCase.value: Self-installation in a safe area by removing the aluminium SIM cover; eSIM also supported

throughCase.label: Mounting points
throughCase.value: Integrated lug for fall prevention; optional EX-ATEXXO-STRAP (original part only)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (Samsung says the Active5 can act as a walkie-talkie; Atexxo does not list PTT; Active Key is programmable)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (camera-based; no dedicated scan engine)

capabilities.label: 3D scanning / LiDAR
capabilities.value: Not possible (base tablet has no depth sensor)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras retained; camera marketed as an intrinsically safe video camera)
